name: @g_tutorial_line_count
comment (tutorial / event info page glo: number of entries written to the page line table (1 per text, 2 per player stat pair)

name: @g_tutorial_display_ticks
comment (tutorial / event info page glo: display time of the page, set to 0x8E8 when the lines are built

name: @g_tutorial_line_entries
comment (tutorial / event info page glo: line table (0x14 dwords): text id at +0, value/second text id at +4 of each entry (interleaved)

name: @g_tutorial_line_width
comment (tutorial / event info page glo: summed text width of the lines plus 8 px gaps, used to centre the line

name: @g_tutorial_reset_requested
comment (tutorial / event info page glo: non zero: tutorial_state_reset runs on the next tutorial_text_update

name: @g_tutorial_ranked_players
comment (tutorial / event info page glo: 4 player ids ordered by the page's stat kind (player_stat_get_by_kind output)
